title: 第19章 神药出世第20章 对天发誓由爱吃星辰的榴莲独家冠名－首秀后再补加更
slug: 氪金仙尊首先6元即赠绝色剑仙
content_zh:
青云宗。
赤霄峰顶——
青玄道人一周只会出关讲道一次，每次两个时辰。
讲完之后会再给一个时辰的时间解答麾下弟子在修炼途中遇到的疑问。
此刻赤霄峰一众弟子汇聚于峰顶那棵不知道长了多少年的苍松下。
讲道已经结束，正是答疑解惑的时间。
陆长天第一个起身，行罢跪拜大礼，方才望着那苍松下的一席青衣提问：“师父，听说宗主亲传弟子赵凌天与魔修战斗时被一掌打碎丹田，现在宗主正在为修复赵凌天的丹田发愁，不惜耗费重金……这丹田就真的没有办法修复吗？”
这问题一出，苍松下另外几人神情各异。
毕竟丹田破碎的人可不只是宗主亲传赵凌天。
还有他们曾经的五师妹——李清然。
青玄道人闻言闭着的双眸眯开一条细缝，捋了捋胡子，淡淡道：“丹田并非不可修复，只是缺一味上古神药，有那神药哪怕丹田没了都能复原，若是没有，就比登天还难！”
“敢问师父，是何神药？”
“混元补天丹！”青玄道人一字一顿。
众人面面相觑，光听这名字就感觉心头一震。
好东西！
只听青玄道人娓娓道来：
“所有生灵诞生之时丹田就已经固定，乃是定数！
每个人的丹田品质不同，容纳的灵气量和灵气质量也不同。就修仙天赋而言，丹田的影响并没有灵根那么明显，但随着修为一步步向着高深进发，当两个同样修为，同样灵根天赋的修士战到一起，丹田品质的差别就会体现出来。
上古时期，灵气尚充裕之时，大能还将丹田分为九品。九品最次，一品最优。一品丹田海纳百川，淬炼灵气的速度极快，转化的灵气无比精纯，那个时候光看丹田就能确定一个修士最终能走多远，宗门也更加看重弟子丹田的质量。”
“那，师父，您看我的丹田是多少品？”

张寒啸上前两步，自信地扒拉两下肚子。
他觉得自己的丹田就很不错，修炼速度快，灵气也还算浑厚。
哪只青玄道人只是斜了他一眼，嘴里嗤了一声：“你？”
“不入品！”
张寒啸：“……”
苍松下响起一阵哄笑。
张寒啸脸顿时黑了，恨不得找个地缝往里钻。
却听青玄道人又道：“笑什么笑？你们大多都不入品，只有陆长天的丹田勉强可以算个七品，放在上古灵气充裕的时期，你们只能在外门做杂役，给宗门镇兽打扫粪便！
也就是如今苍云界灵气枯竭，灵气质量越来越低，丹田对修为和战力的影响反而赶不上灵根和一些身外之物，你们这才有资格成为内门或者亲传。”
众人不笑了，脸色惨淡。
寥寥几句话就已经把座下弟子全部打击一遍，青玄道人这才把话题扯回来：“修士的丹田是定数，破碎了就破碎了，绝不能修复，正如覆水难收，但天衍四九，人遁其一。上古时期有一丹师从补天石中取那一线变数勘破天机炼出混元补天丹，这神药即可让丹田的定数成为变数。不仅能修复丹田还能让丹田品质更进一步，而这，只是凡品混元补天丹的功效！仙品有如何功效，估计只有那位上古丹师才知道了……”
青玄道人说完，众人皆露出向往之色。
如果现在能获得一颗混元补天丹，再拿去献给宗主，他们这辈子或许都不用为修炼资源发愁了吧。
“下个月中洲有小型上古秘境开放，其中不仅有妖兽战场，据说还有上古修士的洞府，说不定就能在其中找到这种神药呢？”陆长天神情振奋。按青玄道人的意思他的丹田现在是七品，若是能得到一颗混元补天丹，他丹田怎么也得提升到六品甚至五品吧？
“你们可以去碰碰运气。”青玄道人点了点头。
其实他心里并不看好，那混元补天丹放在上古时期也是稀罕物，又怎会出现在小型秘境中，不过进入秘境到底是一番历练，还能获取些资源，他就不打击这些弟子了。
“今日讲道到此为止，都回洞府去吧。”
青玄道人袖袍一挥就要遣散弟子。
然而，就在这时。
轰——！

一道青光不知从何而来，冲天而起。
content_en:
Qingyun Sect.
The top of Chixiao Peak——
Taoist Qingxuan will only go out to preach once a week, for two hours each time.
After the lecture, another hour will be given to answer the questions that the disciples under his command encountered during their cultivation.
At this moment, all the disciples of Chixiao Peak gathered under the old pine tree at the top of the peak.
The sermon has ended and it’s time to answer questions.
Lu Changtian was the first to stand up. After bowing and bowing, he looked at a group of people in green clothes under the pine tree and asked, "Master, I heard that Zhao Lingtian, a direct disciple of the sect leader, was shattered by a palm when he was fighting a demon cultivator. Now the sect leader is worrying about repairing Zhao Lingtian's dantian and is spending a lot of money... Is there really no way to repair this dantian?"
As soon as this question came up, the other people under the pines had different expressions.
After all, it wasn't just Zhao Lingtian, the sect leader's personal successor, who had his Dantian broken.
And their former fifth junior sister Li Qingran.
Upon hearing this, Taoist Qingxuan narrowed his closed eyes to a narrow slit, smoothed his beard, and said calmly: "The Dantian is not irreparable, but it just lacks an ancient magic medicine. With that magic medicine, even if the Dantian is gone, it can be restored. If not, it will be harder than climbing to the sky!"
"May I ask Master, what kind of magic medicine is it?"
"Hunyuan Tianbu Dan!" Taoist Qingxuan said every word.
Everyone looked at each other, feeling their hearts tremble just by hearing this name.
nice one!
Just listen to what Taoist Qingxuan said:
"The Dantian is already fixed when all living beings are born, it is a fixed number!
The quality of each person's Dantian is different, and the amount and quality of spiritual energy they can hold are also different. In terms of talent for cultivating immortals, the influence of the Dantian is not as obvious as that of the spiritual root. However, as the cultivation level advances step by step, when two monks with the same cultivation level and the same spiritual root talent fight together, the difference in the quality of the Dantian will be reflected.
In ancient times, when spiritual energy was still abundant, great powers divided the Dantian into nine levels. The ninth grade is the worst and the first grade is the best. A first-grade dantian can absorb all kinds of rivers, tempering spiritual energy very quickly, and the transformed spiritual energy is extremely pure. At that time, just looking at the dantian could determine how far a monk could go in the end, and the sect also valued the quality of the disciple's dantian. "
"Well, Master, what do you think my Dantian is?"
Zhang Hanxiao took two steps forward and stretched his stomach confidently.
He feels that his Dantian is very good, his cultivation speed is fast, and his spiritual energy is quite strong.
The Qingxuan Taoist just glanced at him sideways and snorted: "You?"
"Not good enough!"
Zhang Hanxiao: "..."
There was a burst of laughter under the pine trees.
Zhang Hanxiao's face suddenly turned dark, and he wished he could find a crack in the ground and burrow into it.
But I heard Taoist Qingxuan say again: "Why are you laughing? Most of you are not in the first grade, and only Lu Changtian's Dantian can barely be regarded as a seventh grade. In the ancient times when spiritual energy was abundant, you could only work as handymen in the outer sect, cleaning up the excrement of the sect's beasts!
That is to say, the spiritual energy of the Cangyun Realm is now exhausted, the quality of the spiritual energy is getting lower and lower, and the impact of the Dantian on cultivation and combat power cannot keep up with the spiritual roots and some external objects. Only then do you qualify to become an inner sect or direct disciple. "
Everyone stopped laughing and looked pale.
A few words had already hit all the disciples in the audience, and Taoist Qingxuan brought the topic back: "A monk's Dantian is destined to be broken. If it is broken, it will be broken. It can never be repaired, just like it is difficult to recover when it is covered with water. However, there are four nine kinds of Tianyan, and people can escape one of them. In ancient times, there was an alchemy master who took that one from the Sky-Building Stone. Xian variable surveyed the sky to refine the Hunyuan Tianbu Dan. This magical medicine can not only repair the Dantian but also improve the quality of the Dantian. And this is just the effect of the ordinary Hunyuan Tianbu Dan! I guess only the ancient alchemist knows how effective it is..."
After Taoist Qingxuan finished speaking, everyone looked longingly.
If they could obtain a Hunyuan Tian-Building Pill now and present it to the sect master, they might not have to worry about cultivation resources in this life.
“Next month, a small ancient secret realm will be opened in Central Continent.Come on, there is not only a battlefield of monsters, but also a cave of ancient monks. Maybe you can find this magical medicine in it? "Lu Changtian looked excited. According to Taoist Qingxuan, his Dantian is now at the seventh level. If he can get a Hunyuan Tianbu Dan, his Dantian must be upgraded to the sixth or even fifth level, right?
“You can try your luck. "Taoist Qingxuan nodded.
In fact, he was not optimistic about it. The Hunyuan Tianbu Dan was a rare thing in ancient times, so how could it appear in a small secret realm? However, entering the secret realm was a lot of experience and could also obtain some resources, so he would not attack these disciples.
“That’s the end of today’s sermon, let’s all go back to the cave. "
Taoist Qingxuan will dismiss his disciples with a wave of his sleeve.
However, at this moment.
Boom——!
A ray of green light came from nowhere and shot into the sky.
